# f5xc_virtual_network (Data Source)

Virtual network is an isolated L3 network. A virtual network can contain<br>one or more IP Subnets. Network elements in a virtual network (interface,<br>host, listener etc...) can talk to each other directly.<br><br>Two virtual networks can have overlapping ip address space. If two networks<br>are connected directly then they will have to guarantee unique ip addressing.<br><br>List of sites where virtual network configuration needs to be present can<br>be configured.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Example: Virtual Network - Full

data "f5xc_virtual_network" "example" {
  name      = f5xc_virtual_network.example.name
  namespace = f5xc_virtual_network.example.namespace
}
```
